query:
SELECT 
  c.id,
  c.name,
  c.occupation,
  GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(ccf.fieldName, ':', ccf.fieldValue) SEPARATOR '; ') as custom_fields
FROM contacts c
LEFT JOIN contact_custom_fields ccf ON c.id = ccf.contactId
WHERE c.parentUserId = (SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = 'Jiang')
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.occupation
ORDER BY c.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 25;
